title: ZEUS Quarterly Financial Summary
content:
ZEUS Quarterly Financial Summary · Page 1
Section 1 reports the unaudited consolidated statements for the
three months ended 2024-09-30.
Total revenue for the three months ended 2024-09-30 was
USD 412,300,000, against USD 361,800,000 for the comparable
three months ended 2023-09-30, an increase of 13.96%.
Gross profit was USD 247,380,000, a gross margin of 60.0%.
Net income for the same three months was USD 61,845,000, and
diluted earnings per share were USD 1.42.
Net cash provided by operating activities for the nine months
ended 2024-09-30 was USD 98,700,000. The balance sheet held
cash and cash equivalents of USD 214,500,000 at 2024-09-30
and no debt was outstanding.
These figures are unaudited and all amounts are in USD.

ZEUS Quarterly Financial Summary · Page 2
Section 2 reports segment results and the full-year outlook
issued on 2024-10-28.
AEGIS segment revenue for the three months ended 2024-09-30
was USD 288,610,000, up 16.2% year on year. HELIOS segment
revenue for the same three months was USD 123,690,000, up 9.8%
year on year.
Full-year 2024 revenue guidance is USD 1,610,000,000 at the low
end and USD 1,640,000,000 at the high end. Guidance was
issued on 2024-10-28 by Daniel Okonkwo, Chief Financial
Officer, and was not changed during the quarter.
ZEUS does not expect to pay a quarterly dividend before the
first quarter of 2025. All amounts are in USD.
